assumptions: Human decision F3 (a): checked 0 with only weak-test findings abstains (exit 3, abstained: true) under both soft and hard gates, keeping the weak-test findings visible; not re-asked.

The rule keys on the scored-unit count (`checked`, i.e. scoredResults.length), not on `kept`. A diff whose source units were all consumed by the heuristic-noise filter, with only weak-test findings and no coverage, already abstained before this change via the #761 coverage rule (weak-test findings are heuristic-fidelity); this change only alters its headline, from 'no coverage data (0 files judged heuristically)' to 'no source unit checked (only added tests were judged)'.

The headline and body pick the #1305 copy whenever an abstained run has checked 0, with no new GateMeta field: checked 0 means no source unit was judged, so the #761 'judged heuristically' copy was never accurate there.

No exported predicate: the rule is one inline expression in cli.ts, to keep net guardian source growth at +8 lines under the serial module-size ratchet with #1383; the CLI tests pin it (the revert check fails 5 of them).

The #508 remediation lines printed by abstainPrCheck are not printed on the weak-only path: their advice (fetch-depth, skipGlobs) is about a collapsed denominator, while a test-only diff is a correctly scoped diff that simply contains no source.

The weak-test finding's own evidence text '(advisory — never blocks the gate)' stays: the finding still never gates; the exit 3 comes from checking zero units, and the same finding beside a checked source unit still exits 0 (pinned by a positive test).
The sticky comment's no-findings branch is unaffected: weak-test findings are never suppressed, so a weak-only abstention always renders the findings table.
